chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch 373: Han Li Lands on Starfall Island
chapter_meta_description: Han Li arrives at Starfall Island in the Scattered Star Seas, learns the local language, secures a temporary token, and spends a month recovering his cultivation in a solitary wooden hut. The quiet before the storm.
og_title: Chapter 373: Han Li Lands on Starfall Island
og_description: Han Li arrives on a new island in the Scattered Star Seas, bribes a Foundation Establishment gatekeeper, and sets up a quiet base on a lonely hill.
twitter_title: Han Li’s new base: a hill hut, strange fruits, and a green token to the Scattered Star Seas.
twitter_description: In this quiet chapter, our mortal protagonist does what he does best: methodically recover cultivation and scan a new environment for leverage.

lore_anchors.definition: A Foundation Establishment cultivator assigned as a harbor inspector on Starfall Island; his role as a high-level gatekeeper reinforces the dense cultivator population of the Scattered Star Seas.
A temporary identification token issued to incoming cultivators; losing it results in punishment for trespassing, but retaining it signals visitor status rather than permanent settlement.
A soulless corpse-servant controlled by Han Li via the Soul Summoning Bell; its lingering spiritual aura here raises the interest of local cultivators.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li choose to stay on a hill instead of in the Gu family mansion?
cultural_notes_faq.a: For tactical isolation and strategic control; he avoids entangling himself in daily family politics and can observe the estate from a distance. This is classic Han Li: always keep your options open and your sleeping place off the beaten path.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the green token for?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a temporary entry pass for cultivators arriving on Starfall Island. You need it to prove you're not a trespasser; if you settle permanently, it's taken back. Han Li wisely keeps it for now, preserving his visitor status.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did Han Li really recover to Layer 5 in one month?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, his foundation was solid before losing power; his body remembers the path. This is a sign that his cultivation base—though drained—was never truly destroyed, just suppressed.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Foundation Establishment cultivator act so bored?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because checking tokens and bribing newcomers in a harbor is a degrading assignment for a Foundation Establishment cultivator. He's powerful but stuck with a low-status job—classic Mortal Stream systemic waste of talent.
